purpose: Project the target-blind V19BB Abell 2146 member ensemble onto the frozen V19H Chandra tangent grid using the unchanged V19BA unsmoothed luminosity, signed line-of-sight current, and positive second-moment definitions, while retaining every missing-photometry row in completeness accounting and without fitting a propagation length, opening lensing data, or changing gravity physics.

population.missing_photometry_rule: Retain every row and sampled position in completeness and grid-coverage accounting, but deposit no luminosity, current, or second moment for a row whose V19BB relative_f814w_luminosity is blank. Do not impute it.
population.transverse_velocity_rule: Remain unmeasured_not_imputed; V19BC constructs only line-of-sight current and stress moments.

grid.source: the primary HDU WCS and shape of the frozen V19H Abell 2146 analysis mask
grid.deposition: four-pixel bilinear cloud-in-cell using zero-based floating WCS pixel coordinates
grid.boundary_rule: Every sampled member position, including missing-photometry states, must have all four cloud-in-cell neighbors inside the full grid; do not clip or renormalize a source at a boundary.
grid.analysis_mask_role: Report moment coverage inside the X-ray analysis mask but retain finite-luminosity members elsewhere on the common full tangent grid.
grid.frozen_parent_coverage_facts: All 516096 sampled positions have four in-grid neighbors and no member position falls outside the nearest-pixel V19H X-ray analysis mask. This check used only position and finite/missing state, not a current moment or lensing target.

projected_moments.ell_i: the unchanged V19BB relative HST F814W luminosity 10^[-0.4*(A_F814W-20)] when measured
projected_moments.sufficient_statistic_role: For any later nonnegative long-wave operator H_L, form the line-of-sight velocity-covariance source as H_L[Pi] - H_L[j]^2/H_L[rho]. V19BC does not select or fit H_L or L.

uncertainty_summary.per_pixel_outputs: Across-draw mean, population standard deviation, and all three pairwise covariances of rho_L, j_parallel, and Pi_parallel_parallel.
uncertainty_summary.sample_outputs: For every draw, store total deposited luminosity, signed current, positive second moment, finite/missing luminosity counts, luminosity-weighted mean beta, nonnegative global beta variance, RMS speed, and analysis-mask luminosity fraction.
uncertainty_summary.no_gaussian_approximation_claim: The mean/covariance FITS is a compact summary; the authoritative non-Gaussian positional, photometric-state, and velocity distribution remains the V19BB ensemble.

gates.failure_rule: Fail closed without clipping a member, widening the grid, changing deposition, imputing missing F814W or transverse velocities, smoothing the maps, or selecting a theory parameter after seeing the moments.

claim_boundary: V19BC measures projected relative F814W luminosity, line-of-sight current, and line-of-sight second-moment morphology; it does not detect a new gravitational field.
The second moment is a collisionless luminosity-weighted stress proxy, not gas pressure, total pressure, absolute energy density, or a three-dimensional stress tensor.
A future long-wave covariance requires a separately frozen propagation operator and universal scale; V19BC deliberately supplies unsmoothed sufficient moments only.
Missing-photometry rows remain explicit in every draw but contribute no invented luminosity or current.
No lensing coordinates, inferred dark-matter maps, halo fits, gravity residuals, or Sigma constants enter this protocol.
